name: User Ratings' dashboard page as admin: the four tabs Settings | Moderation | Data | Diagnostics in that order, one panel shown at a time, the arrow keys, Home and End moving between them (WAI-ARIA tabs); the Settings tab reads the settings in (the web client switch as saved), and its Record web client problems switch round-trips through Save and a reload while every other setting keeps its value; Diagnostics shows this build's version (the one the web script reports) from GET /UserRatings/Admin/Diagnostics, and the ratings database at schema 4 and Ok with its snapshots and counts, no warning above the tabs; Data shows Detached & ambiguous with its counts and its held ratings' sentence; and at phone width nothing scrolls the page sideways. EnableWebUi and ReportWebAnchorProblems end as they began.

steps.name: EnableWebUi is on, so its switch on shows the Settings tab has read the settings in
the page, its tab list and the settings read in
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#UserRatingsConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const s = p && p.querySelector('#UserRatingsSettingsRoot [data-jfur-field="EnableWebUi"] [role=switch]'); return !!p && !!p.querySelector('#UserRatingsTabs') && !!s && s.getAttribute('aria-checked') === String(__vars.before.EnableWebUi === true); })()

steps.name: the four tabs, in their order, Settings selected and its panel the only one shown
steps.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#UserRatingsConfigPage:not(.hide)'); return { tabs: [...p.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]')].map(t => ({ text: t.textContent.trim(), selected: t.getAttribute('aria-selected'), tabindex: t.getAttribute('tabindex'), panel: t.getAttribute('aria-controls') })), shown: [...p.querySelectorAll('[role=tabpanel]')].filter(x => !x.classList.contains('hide')).map(x => x.id) }; })()

steps.name: Settings, Moderation, Data, Diagnostics; one tab stop
steps.assert: JSON.stringify(__vars.tabs.tabs.map(t => t.text)) === JSON.stringify(['Settings', 'Moderation', 'Data', 'Diagnostics']) && __vars.tabs.tabs.filter(t => t.tabindex === '0').length === 1 && __vars.tabs.tabs[0].selected === 'true' && JSON.stringify(__vars.tabs.shown) === JSON.stringify(['UserRatingsSettings'])
steps.message: the tabs aren't the four, or more than the Settings panel is shown

steps.name: the ratings database: schema 4 (M004), Ok, its counts, and no warning above the tabs
steps.message: Diagnostics doesn't show userratings.db at schema 4 and Ok with its counts, or a warning is shown above the tabs

steps.name: Data → Detached & ambiguous: the counts by reason with the total, and the held ratings' part
steps.waitFor: (function (box) { var t = box ? box.textContent : ''; return t.indexOf('Removed from the library') >= 0 && t.indexOf('Detached in all') >= 0 && t.indexOf('Kept on items that are gone') >= 0; })(document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDetached'))
steps.message: Data doesn't show Detached & ambiguous with its counts and its held ratings' part

steps.name: turn Record web client problems over (its switch)
saved: the setting changed, every other one kept
steps.waitFor: (async () => { const c = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration('f53c7c34-8cba-4846-b43b-956816b2f6ae'); const b = __vars.before; return c.ReportWebAnchorProblems === !b.ReportWebAnchorProblems && c.EnableWebUi === b.EnableWebUi && c.WhoCanRate === b.WhoCanRate && JSON.stringify(c.RateableItemTypes) === JSON.stringify(b.RateableItemTypes) && c.MaxReviewLength === b.MaxReviewLength && c.DeletedUserPolicy === b.DeletedUserPolicy; })()

steps.name: reload the page: the box reads the saved value
the page again, the settings read in (the web client switch on) and Record web client problems as saved
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#UserRatingsConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const w = p && p.querySelector('#UserRatingsSettingsRoot [data-jfur-field="EnableWebUi"] [role=switch]'); const r = p && p.querySelector('#UserRatingsSettingsRoot [data-jfur-field="ReportWebAnchorProblems"] [role=switch]'); return !!w && !!r && w.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true' && r.getAttribute('aria-checked') === String(!(__vars.before.ReportWebAnchorProblems === true)); })()

steps.name: the configuration as it began
steps.waitFor: (async () => { const c = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration('f53c7c34-8cba-4846-b43b-956816b2f6ae'); return JSON.stringify(c) === JSON.stringify(__vars.before); })()
